data.name: Pro Football Online
data.detailed_description:
What makes Pro Football Online so good?

1) Input Driven Gameplay

Gameplay in Pro Football Online is completely input driven, not animation driven like many other sports games. Your decisions and skills on the field are the only thing that matter in this game.

2) No pay to win mechanics

Pro Football Online aims to be the most competitive and satisfying sports gaming experience there is. Having pay to win would completely ruin that. There are no pay to win mechanics in Pro Football Online.

3) Dedicated servers

Pro Football Online has dedicated servers in NA (Ohio), EU (Milan) and potential to add more locations in the future.

4) Player customization

Customize your player in different ways like choosing your skin & eye color, hair and facial hair style and colors, different helmets and shoulder pad styles, shoes and accessories as well as different emotes.

5) Team customization

You can create multiple team presets that allow you to customize things like the team name, abbreviation, logo, uniforms with custom colors and different patterns/designs.

data.short_description: Pro Football Online is a 1st/3rd person, highly skill based, online multiplayer American Football game. It offers a sports game experience unlike any other with smooth, physics based, input driven gameplay that is competitive and rewarding with no pay to win mechanics.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor at 2.5 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any DirectX 11 or 12 compatible card for Windows
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-Bit
  • Processor: 16 core Intel or AMD processor at 3.4 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3080 or AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT or higher
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
